_comment: SUBAGENT spawn map only (never overrides the human's interactive model). Two rungs: junior = bounded child with a runnable check; escalation = fresh child after STUCK or a failed check. The senior is the interactive parent, set in the product UI, not listed here. Only Codex has a real model spread today; the other platforms ladder by effort on their one good model. Snapshot 2026-09-18: API Pareto is GPT-heavy; this host follows subscription quota. Soft nudge via hooks/guardlib/model_family.py. Cursor Task has no separate effort field (slug suffix). Codex has no model_family adapter yet; slugs here are for parents reading the file.

snapshot.source: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index vs Cost (API list prices)

rungs.junior: bounded child: goal, allowed paths, runnable check, budget; returns the fixed report
rungs.escalation: fresh child after `STUCK: out of ideas.` or a failed check; never resume the stuck child

junior.note: effort via agent-file frontmatter (vendor docs 2026-09-18); Agent tool has no effort param

capabilities.note: Claude agent frontmatter is source metadata; generated Antigravity files carry in-family model/effort and subagent: true.

junior.note: CursorBench 4.0 (2026-09-21): 4.7 low matches 4.6 low; medium is the upgrade (41.6% at $3.49). Slug cursor-grok-4.7-medium. Task has no separate effort field. 256k window; 500k is a 2x bill once input exceeds 256k.

escalation.note: CursorBench 4.0: extra high is 46.3% at $6.01, level with Opus 5 extra high at about half the price. Slug cursor-grok-4.7-xhigh. Senior default stays Grok 4.7 high in the product UI, not this file.

capabilities.note: Claude agent frontmatter is source metadata; generated Cursor files carry an in-family slug. Live 2026-09-20: source model opus is applied at subagentStart and denied.

escalation.note: rarely; often dies mid-prompt; ask the user first if quota is thin
